stages.name: Requirements From Story
stages.details: Drafted OCTOFITAI-16 Daily Tracker requirements: DailyEntry CRUD, last-7-days UI, bootstrap dailyEntries, JSON/Mongo persistence, and Playwright create/update coverage.

stages.name: Architecture From Requirements
stages.details: Daily Tracker layered like nutrition/routine: /api/daily-entries CRUD, unique userId+date, JSON/Mongo, async bootstrap dailyEntries, static nav+panel.

stages.name: Design Review
stages.details: Reviewed Daily Tracker architecture: closed 409-vs-upsert UX, async bootstrap+catch(next), stale activityIds on PUT; CORS/204/dual-store accepted.

stages.name: Implementation Planning
stages.details: Daily Tracker impl-plan: 4 backend, 6 frontend, 4 shared (0 blocked); locked 409/hydrate, async bootstrap, live activityIds, local todayIsoDate.

stages.name: Implementation
stages.details: Daily Tracker shipped: 50/50 backend tests pass (13 new daily-entry). Playwright spec added; e2e blocked (no Chromium).

stages.name: Review
stages.details: approve-with-findings: Daily Tracker product delta matches FR-01–FR-14; PUT 404 unit test gap (medium); Playwright blocked on Chromium (verify).

stages.name: Verify
stages.details: PASS: 52/52 backend tests (PUT 404 + GET invalid date added). Playwright 2/2 after Chromium install and fresh :3000 server. Frontend Daily Tracker confirmed.
